name: build-brief
description: Compile plain-language software intent into the smallest sufficient design contract and gate supported local edits until it passes.

interface.longDescription: Build Brief translates non-trivial software requests and repository context into the smallest Design Contract that satisfies the required behavior. It reuses existing structure unless a present need justifies added complexity, then gates supported write tools until the contract is recorded. Users can build automatically, review the contract first, or request a handoff-ready directive without coding.
defaultPrompt: Compile the smallest sufficient design contract, pass the mutation gate, then build this request.
Show me the design contract first and wait for approval before coding.
Turn this request into a handoff-ready engineering directive without coding.
